confidence_notes: Medium confidence: holistic estimates from general knowledge, calibrated to the supplied Lisbon and Madrid USD values with a modest Porto discount on food and drink; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Accommodation for July peak season is the least certain. Beer is priced for a 0.5 L draught to match the comparables. Cocktail and wine are derived from the beer anchor (about 2.9x and 1.3x) because no direct comparables were supplied. FX figure is the 14 Oct 2026 RBA 4pm rate as shown in search-result text attributed to the rba.gov.au homepage; the RBA page itself was not opened directly, no 15 Oct figure was found, and the value is about 0.4% above third-party quotes for the same day, so verify before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Lisbon is the closest comparable (same country, similar tourism demand). Porto anchors are set at about 89-98% of Lisbon's values, with food and drink at the lower end and hostel beds at the upper end. Madrid is a secondary cross-check; Reykjavik is excluded as a high-cost outlier.
